repos_data.description: CometBFT: A distributed, Byzantine fault-tolerant, deterministic state machine replication engine. A fork and successor to Tendermint Core.
Gno: An interpreted, stack-based Go virtual machine to build succinct and composable apps + gno.land: a blockchain for timeless code and fair open-source.
Cosmos is an operating system "construction kit". Build your own OS using managed languages such as C#, VB.NET, and more!
Sandbox for developing and testing UI components in isolation

Full-featured Golang SDK for BingX cryptocurrency exchange API. Supports USDT-M & Coin-M perpetual futures, spot trading, market data, WebSocket streams, account management, and copy trading. Type-safe, production-ready with HMAC-SHA256 security. Complete API coverage with idiomatic Go interfaces.

Idiomatic Go SDK for KuCoin REST & WebSocket APIs — UTA (Unified Trading Account) and Classic (Spot, Margin, Futures). Hand-written, not generated. String-typed prices, HMAC-SHA256 auth, context-aware methods, typed error hierarchy, conservative retry policy, injectable HTTP client, and manifest-driven endpoint documentation.
A decentralized, trusted, high performance, SQL database with blockchain features
MCP server and local sync package for Cosmos. Connects agents, iMessage, browser history, calendar, Claude Desktop, and shell history to a shared personal graph.
